SET DC_KIND="AUTO";
SELECT
    SUM ( 'FactsCost'[unblended_cost] )
FROM 'FactsCost'
    LEFT OUTER JOIN 'DimPricingModel'
        ON 'FactsCost'[Dim_PricingModel.pricing_key]='DimPricingModel'[pricing_key]
WHERE
    'DimPricingModel'[pricing_model] IN ( 'Reserved Instance', 'Savings Plan' ) ;
